The company 

Our client is an American pharmaceutical company with offices in 18 countries.

Jobomschrijving

Mission

You will be responsible for the administrative organization of meetings, the HCP/HCO contracting process, the transparency reports for events with healthcare professionals in respect of budget, local rules, and internal compliance rules.

Customer Focus

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

HCP Meetings And Contracts Management

HealthCare Organisation Sponsorship Management

Compliance

Business Planning And Operations

Requirements 

Minimum education level: Bachelor’s degree.

Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly with all audiences and forums through exemplary English, Dutch and French oral and written communication skills.

Pharmaceutical industry experience, and/or customer service experience in meeting management.

Ability to travel up to 20% (between Belgium and the Netherlands);

Excellent time-management, and critical thinking skills with ability to work effectively in a team, cross-functional, matrix, and global multi-cultural and virtual environment.

Demonstrate strong customer focus with the ability to develop professional relationships in all aspects of the position that result in stable, consistent, reliable, and courteous communication when dealing with other key business partners and external customers.

Strong proficiency and learning agility with various computer applications and software.

Ability to solve problems and work independently in a changing and multi-tasking environment with numerous deadlines. 

Additional info:

Contract of limited duration of 1 year

The company  is een familie bedrijf actief in de Security wereld in België en Nederland. 

Jobomschrijving

Your Mission

•    Coordinate maintenance contracts and ensure contractual commitments are fulfilled.•    Plan and follow up preventive maintenance activities.•    Coordinate service reviews, reporting activities and follow-up actions.•    Monitor maintenance invoicing, renewals and contract amendments.•    Maintain contract documentation, service procedures and operational records throughout the contract lifecycle.•    Act as the operational reference for maintenance contracts and contract-related information across the company.•    Support engineers and internal teams with contract-related questions.•    Coordinate subcontractors and ensure service activities are properly tracked.•    Support customer communication and manage operational escalations when required.•    Identify risks, priorities and improvement opportunities before they impact service management.

During your journey at Tein Technology, you'll develop expertise in:•    Service Delivery & Contract Management•    Customer Relationship•    Operational Planning & Coordination•    Service Reporting & Business Performance Monitoring•    Mission-Critical Voice, Video & Network Services

POSITION’S REQUIREMENTS Education, Knowledge & Experience•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.•    Experience in service coordination, operations, administration or customer support.•    Strong organisational and planning skills.•    Interest in technology, customer service and operational excellence.What Makes You a Great Fit•    Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with a good command of English.•    Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.•    Customer-oriented with excellent communication skills.•    Proactive, action-driven and comfortable taking ownership.•    Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and improvements.•    Comfortable coordinating engineers, customers and external partners.•    Structured and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.•    Calm and effective under pressure.•    Curious about technology and service management.•    Eager to grow towards a Service Delivery Management role.

European Association located in the heart of Brussels. 

Jobomschrijving

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support the team to organise workshops and events,

Prepare meetings and events material,

Take care of communication actions, updating websites, registrations, newsletters, etc.

Support team members to fulfil the association's role in the EU-funded projects (timesheets, drafting and submitting reports, etc.).

Archiving documents, updating CRM, and other administration tasks.

Support the team in other ad-hoc assignments related to the day-to-day activities of the association. 

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS 

Degree in communication, administration, project management or related studies. 

Experience in a similar position.

Should be able to work autonomously with little supervision.

Should be well organised, flexible and open-minded. 

Should be able to set priorities, follow strict deadlines, be proactive 

Should have good IT skills (Outlook, Office 365) and communication tools knowledge & understanding 

Knowledge and experience within the European context in Brussels would be highly considered. 

Very good writing and communication skills and a sense of diplomacy. 

Excellent spoken and written English.

European Association in het center of Brussels

Jobomschrijving

Become the backbone of a collaborative team and help drive seamless operations.

Secretariat in general, including•    administrative support to General Secretary and other staff members•    liaise with the office landlord, suppliers and contractors to keep the office welcoming and in good shape•    support the events organisation, i.e. the practicalities (hotel, venue, catering, …) for the yearly “National Association Meetings, “International Harmonisation Council” and a “Summit rehearsal”

Suppliers•    Scouting if needed•    Organizing, ordering & reception of all office supplies, drinks, etc•    Contact with suppliers: e-mail correspondence, telephone requests•    Price quotations, ordering with approval of General Secretary•    Filing of contracts•    Ordering & follow-up of maintenance/repair of material, machines•    In contact with the cleaning service and plants’ service

Building•    Access badges •    Contact with representative of the building workers for the organization and timing of works (avoiding noise & disturbance for & visitors on our busy meeting days)•    Responsible for evacuating  & visitors in every case of alarm and during building escape exercises.  Sending report to the building representative afterwards.•    Organise maintenance of kitchen machines

Mail•    Opening and distribution of mail•    E-Mailing of invitations to Summits •    Checking incoming mail, answering, forwarding•    Clearing inbox of all possible junk, clear spam box

Insurances (except for insurances linked to staff)•    Follow-up of insurances

•    Fluent in English (written and oral). (French, Dutch or other languages are appreciated)•    Experience in a similar function•    Knowledgeable in IT (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

Our client is an international organisation specialising in rail transport.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a little experience in communications and you are looking for experience in an international environment? We're looking for you for a 5-month project (ASAP - Early October) !

Main mission 

The candidate will be responsible for assisting the Communication Officer in the creation and integration of content on their website.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Profile 

Bilingual in French and English, both spoken and written

At least two years' experience in copywriting and content integration in drupal

Very good knowledge of the CMS

Good knowledge of digital marketing, copywriting and SEO

Personality: customer-oriented, creative, proactive, autonomous, good writing and communication skills, good organisational skills, team player

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow our intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.                                                   
Wij bieden
Our offer:

• Permanent contract after 25 days of training!
• Competitive salary 
• A whole bunch of benefits! Think of daily fresh meals in our company restaurant, 25% discount on personal meat orders, fun family activities, Christmas gifts, ... In short, too many to mention! 
• Job security and growth opportunities! Wij vragen
We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.
Het bedrijf
Westvlees guarantees sustainable production of pork. Their mission is to provide a healthy and tasty solution for every consumer at every meal occasion. As an employer, they place great importance on innovation, service, and quality, while centering family values in the company, which are essential to its operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Primarily focused on indirect procurement, with strong exposure to operational and industrial activities.
• Responsible for Transportation & Logistics categories, representing the largest spend area within the portfolio.
• Oversees procurement of Maintenance, Engineering Services, and MRO to support operational continuity.
• Manages suppliers across technical, industrial, and logistics sectors.
• Collaborates with Category Managers on strategic and global sourcing categories.
• Manages an annual spend of approximately €50M.
• Manage and develop strategic supplier relationships, ensuring optimal performance, compliance, and long-term value creation.
• Lead end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing, tendering, contract negotiation, and supplier selection.
• Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities while maintaining service excellence and operational continuity.
• Collaborate closely with operations, logistics, finance, legal, compliance, and other key stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs.
• Monitor procurement KPIs, provide performance reporting, and contribute to continuous improvement and best-practice initiatives.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
• 4  years if experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supplier management within an international, industrial, logistics, or energy-related environment.
• Strong negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills.
• Ability to influence stakeholders and operate effectively within a matrix organization.
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered a strong asset.
